description.value:
You loose four projectiles at points you can see within range, each detonating in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Every creature caught in a blast makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 15d6 fire damage and 15d6 kinetic damage on a failure, or half of each on a success; a creature within multiple blast radii is affected only once.

The blasts damage objects in the area and ignite unattended flammable material.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 9
